text: This is a poker game. The demo is three gigabytes.
One file inside it is 1.6 of them.
K-God Robot Hunters is a Korean-fantasy poker roguelike. It went up on Steam yesterday.
You play hands, and goddesses rewrite them.
Unity, IL2CPP, 92 files. For a card game that is already a lot of build.
Two thirds of it is eight raw asset streams. The biggest is 1.6 gigabytes on its own.
And every asset bundle in the build is one thing: enemy animation, ante zero through eight.
The cards were never the expensive part. The bosses were. Budget for that before you start. This is Demo Dip.
